layered-dotnet.name: Layered .NET solution (one .csproj per layer)
layered-dotnet.detect: a folder with a .slnx/.sln and child projects <Name>.Api / .Application / .Domain / .Infrastructure
notes: Domain and Application are empty shells (Class1.cs only) as of init
Persistence (EF Core, SQL Server) and Identity live in Infrastructure; see services/api/docs/architecture/persistence.md

vite-react-spa.name: Vite + React (JSX) single-page app
vite-react-spa.detect: package.json with react + vite, src/main.jsx and src/App.jsx
notes: No router, no TypeScript, no test runner; all shared state in src/App.jsx
